name: printful-mcp
description: Printful (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, create_order, get_order. Every tool

platform_mcp_printful_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_PRINTFUL_TOKEN
platform_mcp_printful_token.description: Printful private (store-level) token or OAuth access token, sent as `Authorization: Bearer`. Account-level tokens also need the X-PF-Store-Id header, which the runtime cannot send: use a store token.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /oauth/scopes returns the scopes of the token ({code, result: {scopes: [{scope, display_name}]}}).

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Printful catalog products (blanks): GET /products?category_id=… returns the whole catalog in one {code, result[]} response (about 550 products). The catalog OpenAPI (https://developers.printful.com/docs/openapi.json) defines only category_id, and a live check (auth audit 2026-09-26, public endpoint) showed offset ignored and no paging object, so page/limit are not sent. `query` is not accepted; `category` maps to category_id.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: result.product; the variants [{id, name, size, color, price, currency, in_stock}] are in the sibling result.variants (not in `raw`, which is the product only).

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Creates a DRAFT order (the `confirm` query parameter is not sent), so nothing is charged until the order is confirmed in Printful. `shipping_address` is Printful's recipient object {name, address1, city, state_code, country_code, zip, phone, email}; `items` are Printful items [{variant_id|sync_variant_id, quantity, files[{url}]}]; `shipping_option` is the shipping method id.
